correctness.rationale: The exact Cauchy brightness reduction and rearrangement yield the 192 cap orbit. Distinct integer permutations have maximal dot 13/14; exactly 384 pairs have this dot, their graph is bipartite, and no other pairs meet before the next threshold 12/14. S^3 projected onto a 2-plane is uniform on its unit disk, giving a direct 2-cap lens integral and exact probability by inclusion-exclusion. A Taylor calculation proves the coefficient 192 sqrt(3)/pi. Standalone exact integer orbit computations, quadrature, and reproducible Monte Carlo passed; finite tests are not the proof.
